pr.title: refactor(providers): split into folder
pr.body: - [feat(cli): update sync to handle merge-restack loop in a one-shot (#28)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/28) - [feat(cli): submitStack config to make bare submit cover stack (#27)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/27) - [feat(stack): submit/restack from anywhere along the stack (#26)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/26) - [feat(docs): add logo and crates.io badge (#25)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/25) - [refactor(tests): split integration suite (#24)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/24) - [refactor(code): centralize stk config keys/resolution (#23)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/23) - [refactor(cli): move command bodies into their own modules (#22)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/22) - [refactor(code): per-command modules Run trait (#21)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/21) - [refactor(providers): split into folder (#20)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/20) 👈 - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: GitLab create_review passes --fill, which makes glab push the current checkout onto the source branch, clobbering a sibling branch when a stack is submitted from its leaf.
